architecture.clock_frequency_note: no maximum clock frequency is claimed; these are architectural cycle counts only. Timing closure is measured in Stage 4.
architecture.product_bank_shared_across: every output neuron of the active layer, every input cycle, and both layers

arithmetic.argmax_tie_rule: lowest index wins (strict > comparison), matching numpy.argmax
arithmetic.signedness_note: the activation is zero extended and explicitly $signed before the multiply, and each alphabet level is a signed 12-bit constant, so no implicit unsigned conversion is possible. The ReLU result is carried in an unsigned 24-bit temporary so the requantisation shift is unambiguously logical.

ports.bias_interface: option B, indexed read: bmem_addr = neuron index, bmem_data = that neuron's signed bias sign extended to 22 bits. Chosen over a wide packed port because finalisation is already one neuron per cycle, so the indexed read costs no extra cycles and keeps the Stage-2 ROM shape identical to the weight interface.
ports.in_ready/in_valid/in_data[7:0]: activation stream handshake; exactly 784 transfers, index order 0..783
ports.logits[179:0]: 10 signed logits of 18 bits, logit j at [j*18 +: 18]
ports.memory_read_semantics: an address driven during cycle T is captured on the posedge ending cycle T; the data must be presented during cycle T+1.
ports.reset_start_done_semantics: rst is synchronous and clears all state. start is sampled while idle and clears the accumulators. done is high for exactly one cycle. prediction_valid is high from that cycle until the next start; logits and prediction hold over the same window.
ports.weight_word_packing: weight_index[i][j] = wmem_data[j*4 +: 4]; wmem_addr = input feature i; Stage-0 orientation [in_features, out_features]; neuron 0 in the least significant nibble; layer 1 uses 128 bits, layer 2 uses 40 bits

structure.note: Stage-0's operator analysis counts a fully UNROLLED design. Stage 1 implements the same arithmetic time multiplexed, so the implemented product-generator count is K = 16 reused over input cycles rather than 25408 (naive) or 13056 (fully spatial MSA). Both Stage-0 numbers remain valid as analytical fully-spatial counts; they are not superseded. The trade is area down, latency up: 864 cycles per inference instead of one.

verification.oracle: Stage-0 NumPy integer golden model (not Keras)
